articles.summary: Hilltop Securities Inc. (“HilltopSecurities”) today announced the additions of Managing Director Justin Baumgardner and Vice President Loryn DeFalco to its Public Finance division. Justin Baumgardner Baumgardner and DeFalco join HilltopSecurities’ Higher Education and Nonprofit Group from Truist Securities. They will be based in Charlotte, NC and report to Senior Managing Director Rochelle Powell, Head of the Higher Education and Nonprofit Group. Baumgardner brings more than 14 years of public finance experience serving colleges, universities, foundations and nonprofit organizations. At Truist Securities, he established and led the firm’s Higher Education and Nonprofit Public Finance coverage platform, overseeing business development, client relationships, and the execution of complex financing transactions.
